description:
Score a site 0–100 on agent readiness: can an AI assistant acting for a buyer reach it, read what it sells and at what price, and find its machine interfaces.

Billing: free. Fetches ~10–14 URLs in 5–15 s; cached 10 min per URL; 30 uncached checks per hour per host.

When to call: agentic commerce ('can ChatGPT buy from us'), MCP or agent discoverability. Whether AI search crawlers may crawl: check_ai_crawlers; one page's SEO health: run_technical_audit.

Checks: agent fetchers allowed in robots.txt; no bot wall as ChatGPT-User; Product / SoftwareApplication / Service JSON-LD with an Offer price; prices in the pricing page's server HTML; an MCP server card; robots.txt Content-Signal; UCP/ACP checkout (stores only); A2A agent card. A store's Product markup is graded on a product page (store_reason, product_url); none found: offer_schema "na".

Returns { domain, score, grade, store, store_reason, product_url, pricing_url, schema_urls_checked, checks: [{ key, label, status: pass|partial|fail|na, earned, possible, why, detail, fix: { summary, code? } | null }], suggested_next, next_step, blocked?, not_checked? }. blocked (401/403/429/503): { http_status, as_agent_http_status, summary } plus not_checked; relay blocked.summary as written, and don't call the site invisible to AI search from it.

domain.description: Hostname or URL, e.g. "example.com"; a product page URL also grades its Product markup.

name: check_agent_readiness
title: Check whether AI agents can discover, read and buy from a site
